Normal stETH/wstETH vs ETH basis moves are small (<1% typically), but wstETH yield accrual actually helps collateral side. The main risk is ETH price drop — but both collateral and debt are ETH-correlated, so HF is mostly insensitive to ETH price; it's sensitive to the wstETH/ETH exchange rate and to interest accrual on debt (WETH borrow rate at 89% utilization is high, debt grows fast).

Standard loop unwind: repay some WETH debt first (reduces debt, raises HF), then withdraw collateral, swap wstETH→WETH, repay more, etc. Repaying WETH requires having WETH or acquiring it. The user could sell wstETH on external DEX (Curve wstETH/WETH pool is deep) for WETH without touching Aave, then repay debt on Aave, then withdraw collateral. That works regardless of borrow caps.
